name: Aim for 1 Million! Influencer Dream
description:
What if one post could turn things around in a flash?

Plenty of people dream of standing out online, but picking the detail that will get noticed can be trickier than it first seems.

This breezy visual quiz captures the influencer dream one scene at a time. Each stage gives you a single illustration, and there is just one spot that matches the prompt.

How to play:
・Read the prompt
・Look over the illustration
・Choose the one correct spot

Some answers click the moment you see them, while others make you pause and have another look. That quick bit of doubt keeps each stage fun and snappy.

Dip in for a quick go during a break, or take your time with all 150 stages. Have you got the eye for detail to chase that 1 million dream?
